{{Top}}
A '''floodlight''', or '''flood light''', was a broad-beamed, high intensity artificial light used for illumination during low-light conditions. A floodlight was much more powerful than a [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]] and could be used to brightly illuminate an area. They could be part of the external lighting system on a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], or even be placed on droids.

The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was equipped with floodlights, as was [[Ulban Arms/Legends|Ulban Arms']] [[S-EP1 security droid]]. Head-mounted floodlights were used by [[Rocket battle droid/Legends|rocket battle droids]] while they were searching for survivors in the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]], around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. [[Imperial Garrisons]] also used floodlights to search out intruders or escapees. One notable garrison that used such equipment was the [[Vryssa Garrison]] on [[Vryssa]].
